title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติลิโลย์–สาขาย่อยซีลูกาป์ในบารังไกย์ซีลูกาป์อำเภอลิโลย์จังหวัดซัมโบอังกาเดลนอร์เตออกจากการเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติลิโลย์และจัดตั้งให้เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติอิสระภายใต้ชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติซีลูกาป์

text.en: The Liloy National High School - Silucap Extension in Barangay Silucap, Municipality of Liloy, Province of Zamboanga del Norte is hereby separated from the Liloy National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Silucap National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Lilot National High School - Silucap Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Silucap National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Silucap National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Liloy National High School - Silucap Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

Within ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act. Such implementing rules and regulations shall provide for the school's organization, administration, operations and management, in accordance with Republic Act No. 9155, or the "Governance of Basic Education Act of 2001", Republic Act No. 10533, or the "Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013", and other basic education-related laws.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
